# TASK-089 — specification

## Scope

Docker Compose: optional `.env`, required `ENCRYPTION_KEY`, read-only root filesystem with tmpfs, dropped capabilities, `no-new-privileges`, rotated logs, health checks for the app and publisher (new `/health`), Ollama on the host by default (`host.docker.internal`), profiles `ollama` (container plus model pull) and `pdf` (publisher); `compose.split.yaml` (API and nginx images) and `compose.gpu.yaml`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Better Docker Compose: hardening, health checks, optional profiles for Ollama and the PDF publisher; split-image and GPU variants.
